20631-chosen-peoples-being-the-first-art.title: Chosen Peoples Being The First Arthur Davis Memorial Lecture
20631-chosen-peoples-being-the-first-art.creator: The MacMillan Company.
20631-chosen-peoples-being-the-first-art.description: A book by The MacMillan Company.. The recent revelation of racial arrogance in Germany has provided our enemies with a new weapon. "Germanism is Judaism," says a writer in the American _Bookman_. The proposition contains just that dash of truth which is more dangerous than falsehood undiluted; and the saying ascribed to Von Tirpitz in 1915 that the Kaiser spent all his time praying and studying Hebrew may serve to give it colour.

arxiv-1811-07460.title: Segregated Temporal Assembly Recurrent Networks for Weakly Supervised Multiple Action Detection
arxiv-1811-07460.creator: Yunlu Xu Chengwei Zhang Zhanzhan Cheng Jianwen Xie Yi Niu Shiliang Pu Fei Wu
arxiv-1811-07460.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Yunlu Xu Chengwei Zhang Zhanzhan Cheng Jianwen Xie Yi Niu Shiliang Pu Fei Wu. This paper proposes a segregated temporal assembly recurrent (STAR) network for weakly-supervised multiple action detection. The model learns from untrimmed videos with only supervision of video-level labels and makes prediction of intervals of multiple actions. Specifically, we first assemble video clips according to class labels by an attention mechanism that learns class-variable attention weights and thus helps the noise relieving from background or other actions.

arxiv-2110-15080.title: Learning feedback control strategies for quantum metrology
arxiv-2110-15080.creator: Alessio Fallani, Matteo A. C. Rossi, Dario Tamascelli, Marco G. Genoni
arxiv-2110-15080.description: Abstract We consider the problem of frequency estimation for a single bosonic field evolving under a squeezing Hamiltonian and continuously monitored via homodyne detection. In particular, we exploit reinforcement learning techniques to devise feedback control strategies achieving increased estimation precision.

arxiv-2206-15378.title: Mastering the Game of Stratego with Model-Free Multiagent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2206-15378.creator: Julien Perolat, Bart de Vylder, Daniel Hennes, Eugene Tarassov, Florian Strub, Vincent de Boer, Paul Muller, Jerome T. Connor, Neil Burch, Thomas Anthony, Stephen McAleer, Romuald Elie, Sarah H. Cen, Zhe Wang, Audrunas Gruslys, Aleksandra Malysheva, Mina Khan, Sherjil Ozair, Finbarr Timbers, Toby Po
arxiv-2206-15378.description: Abstract We introduce DeepNash , an autonomous agent capable of learning to play the imperfect information game Stratego 1 1 1 Stratego is a trademark of Jumbo Diset Group, and is used in this publication for information purposes only. from scratch, up to a human expert level.

arxiv-2207-06186.title: Lattice control of non-ergodicity in a polar lattice gas
arxiv-2207-06186.creator: H. Korbmacher, P. Sierant, W. Li, X. Deng, J. Zakrzewski, L. Santos
arxiv-2207-06186.description: Abstract Strong-enough inter-site interactions may result in lack of ergodicity in disorder-free many-body lattice systems. Ultra cold dipolar gases in optical lattices provide an experimentally accessible platform for exploring this physics. Dipolar inter-site interactions are usually assumed to decay with a fixed power-law. We show that in a one-dimensional polar lattice gas the actual decay depends on the transversal confinement.

arxiv-2305-13532.title: InProC: Industry and Product/Service Code Classification Conference: ICAIF’22; Small Data, Big Opportunities: Making the Most of AI; 2022 ICAIF, Small Data, Big Opportunities: Making the Most of AI
arxiv-2305-13532.creator: Simerjot Kaur, Andrea Stefanucci, Sameena Shah
arxiv-2305-13532.description: Abstract . Determining industry and product/service codes for a company is an important real-world task and is typically very expensive as it involves manual curation of data about the companies. Building an AI agent that can predict these codes automatically can significantly help reduce costs, and eliminate human biases and errors.

arxiv-2306-07462.title: On the Robustness of Removal-Based Feature Attributions
arxiv-2306-07462.creator: Chris LinUniversity of Washington clin25@cs.washington.edu, Ian CovertStanford University icovert@stanford.edu Su-In LeeUniversity of Washington suinlee@cs.washington.edu
arxiv-2306-07462.description: Abstract To explain predictions made by complex machine learning models, many feature attribution methods have been developed that assign importance scores to input features. Some recent work challenges the robustness of these methods by showing that they are sensitive to input and model perturbations, while other work addresses this issue by proposing robust attribution methods.

arxiv-2402-05027.title: Towards Generalizability of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning in Graphs with Recurrent Message Passing Conference: Proc. of the 23rd International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2024); May 6 – 10, 2024; Auckland, New Zealand 253
arxiv-2402-05027.creator: Jannis Weil, Zhenghua Bao, Osama Abboud, Tobias Meuser
arxiv-2402-05027.description: Abstract . Graph-based environments pose unique challenges to multi-agent reinforcement learning. In decentralized approaches, agents operate within a given graph and make decisions based on partial or outdated observations. The size of the observed neighborhood limits the generalizability to different graphs and affects the reactivity of agents, the quality of the selected actions, and the communication overhead.

arxiv-2407-11500.title: An AI System for Continuous Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Grading: An Anomaly Detection Inspired Approach with Few Labels
arxiv-2407-11500.creator: Niamh Belton 1,2 Aonghus Lawlor 3,4 Kathleen M. Curran 1,2,4 1 Science Foundation Ireland Centre for Research Training in Machine Learning 2 School of Medicine, 3 School of Computer Science, University College Dublin 4 Insight Centre for Data Analytics, University College Dublin, Dublin, Ireland
arxiv-2407-11500.description: Abstract The diagnostic accuracy and subjectivity of existing Knee Osteoarthritis (OA) ordinal grading systems has been a subject of on-going debate and concern. Existing automated solutions are trained to emulate these imperfect systems, whilst also being reliant on large annotated databases for fully-supervised training.

arxiv-2411-07003.title: Enhancing Robot Assistive Behaviour with Reinforcement Learning and Theory of Mind
arxiv-2411-07003.creator: Antonio Andriella, Giovanni Falcone, Silvia Rossi
arxiv-2411-07003.description: Abstract The adaptation to users’ preferences and the ability to infer and interpret humans’ beliefs and intents, which is known as the Theory of Mind (ToM), are two crucial aspects for achieving effective human-robot collaboration. Despite its importance, very few studies have investigated the impact of adaptive robots with ToM abilities.

arxiv-2502-01813.title: Machine Learning-Driven Analytical Models for Threshold Displacement Energy Prediction in Materials
arxiv-2502-01813.creator: Rosty B. Martinez Duque, Arman Duha, Mario F. Borunda
arxiv-2502-01813.description: Abstract Understanding the behavior of materials under irradiation is crucial for the design and safety of nuclear reactors, spacecraft, and other radiation environments. The threshold displacement energy ( E d E_{d} ) is a critical parameter for understanding radiation damage in materials, yet its determination often relies on costly experiments or simulations.

arxiv-2503-11457.title: Fe Abundances of Early Galaxies at z = 9 − 12 z=9-12 Derived with Deep JWST Spectra
arxiv-2503-11457.creator: Minami Nakane, Masami Ouchi, Kimihiko Nakajima, Yoshiaki Ono, Yuichi Harikane, Yuki Isobe, Ken’ichi Nomoto, Miho N. Ishigaki, Hiroto Yanagisawa, Daichi Kashino, Nozomu Tominaga, Koh Takahashi, Moka Nishigaki, Yui Takeda, Kuria Watanabe
arxiv-2503-11457.description: Abstract We derive Fe-abundance ratios of 7 7 galaxies at z = 9 − 12 z=9-12 with − 22 < M UV < − 19 -22<M_{\mathrm{UV}}<-19 whose JWST/NIRSpec spectra achieve very high signal-to-noise ratios, SNR = 60 − 320 \mathrm{SNR}=60-320 , at the rest-frame UV wavelength.

arxiv-2505-23919.description: Abstract A feasibility study for the Standard Model Higgs boson produced in association with a single top-quark or a top-quark pair and a photon ( t ​ H ​ γ tH\gamma and t ​ t ¯ ​ H ​ γ t\bar{t}H\gamma ) is presented, using simulated pp collision data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 350 fb -1 at s

There is no relation between the geographical origin of these stocks and their ability to tolerate this temperature. 2. A single wild stock has been found...

pmc-10611457.title: Effect of Morinda citrifolia fruit powder on physiological and productive performance of Cavia porcellus
pmc-10611457.creator: Daniel Marco Paredes-López, Rizal Alcides Robles-Huaynate, Xiomara Beteta-Blas, Uriel Aldava-Pardave
pmc-10611457.description: The breeding of guinea pig is part of the pluriactivity for millions of farming families in rural areas from the Peruvian Andean and Amazonian regions and other South American Andean countries. Rearing these specie plays an important source of employment, income, and nutrition for millions of rural families on these countries.

pmc-11474954.title: Pilot Assessment of Impacts of Ozone and Ozone/Hydrogen Peroxide Treatment on the Fate of Per- and Polyfluoroalkyl Substances and Precursors
pmc-11474954.creator: Xiaoyue Xin, Juhee Kim, ShihChi Weng, Ching-Hua Huang
pmc-11474954.description: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) make up a large class of anthropogenic micropollutants prevalent in wastewater. Oxidative processes commonly used in wastewater potable reuse treatment may affect transformation of PFAS precursors, leading to elevated concentrations of perfluorinated alkyl acids (PFAAs) that are significant health concerns.

pmc-11643604.title: 1,2-Oxidative Trifluoromethylation of Olefin with Ag(O2CCF2SO2F) and O2: Synthesis of α-Trifluoromethyl Ketones
pmc-11643604.creator: Shengxue Zhang, Wangchuan Xiao, Jingjing Wu, Fanhong Wu, Houjin Huang, Xiaoyu Ma, Yafei Shi, Chao Liu, Roman Dembinski
pmc-11643604.description: A novel and efficient 1,2-oxidative trifluoromethylation of olefins employing Ag(O2CCF2SO2F) as a trifluoromethyl source is described with O2 as the oxidant, which provides access to a variety of valuable α-trifluoromethyl-substituted ketones. The broad substrate scope, feasibility of large-scale operation, and derivatization reactions of α-trifluoromethyl ketones demonstrate the promising utility of this protocol.Keywords: Ag(O2CCF2SO2F), trifluoromethylation, α-trifluoromethyl ketones 1.

pmc-12524937.title: Endoscopic Transorbital Approach and Transcranial Approach in Spheno-Orbital Meningiomas: A Comparative Qualitative and Preliminary Quantitative Anatomical Study
pmc-12524937.creator: Roberta Costanzo, Marcello D’Andrea, Roberto Manfrellotti, Jon Kristinn Nielsen, Roberto Tafuto, Alessia Tomassini, Domenico Gerardo Iacopino, Rosario Maugeri, Luigino Tosatto, Alberto Prats-Galino, Alberto Di Somma, Joaquim Enseñat, Juliet K Haarbauer-Krupa
pmc-12524937.description: Background/Objectives: Spheno-orbital meningiomas (SOMs) are rare tumors described as benign despite their aggressive, osteodestructive behavior. Their invasive nature makes surgical management complex and often precludes complete excision. Reaching structures within the orbit remains challenging, particularly due to insufficient exposure or overly long surgical pathways.

pmc-12607621.title: Changes and Correlations Between the Width and Height of the Hard Palate During Rapid Maxillary Expansion with a Printed Tooth-Borne Expander
pmc-12607621.creator: Mirela Georgieva, Emanuel Emiliyanov, Greta Yordanova
pmc-12607621.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: The nasomaxillary complex is a compound anatomical structure in which the correlation between changes in palatal width and height has been poorly investigated. Methods: A three-year prospective study with 28 patients treated with printed expanders was conducted. Measurements on CBCT images were performed before and after treatment; the width and height parameters were measured on a coronal slice of a CBCT image at the level of the first molars and upper first molar inclination relative to the palatal plane.

pmc-12652348.title: Geospatial Insights into Healthcare Accessibility in Europe: A Scoping Review of GIS Applications
pmc-12652348.creator: Silviya Nikolova, Teodora Aleksandrova, Norbert Buzás
pmc-12652348.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: Geographic Information Systems (GIS) have emerged as a critical tool in healthcare research, facilitating the assessment of healthcare accessibility through spatial analysis and data visualisation. This scoping review synthesises literature published between 2020 and 2024, a period marked by the COVID-19 pandemic and rapid methodological innovation, providing a timely overview of how GIS has been applied to evaluate healthcare access across European countries.

pmc-13184938.title: Cumulative evidence for associations between matrix metalloproteinase-1, -3 and -8 variants and cancer risk
pmc-13184938.creator: Suqin Xu, Xianping Liu, Chenglu Huang
pmc-13184938.description: Matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) gene polymorphisms have been implicated in cancer susceptibility; however, the results from previous studies have been inconsistent across populations and tumor types. The present study aimed to systematically evaluate the associations between MMP-1, MMP-3 and MMP-8 polymorphisms and cancer risk through a comprehensive meta-analysis.

pmc-13468203.title: Nutrition Behaviour During Pregnancy: Eating Twice as Healthy? A Secondary Analysis of the Nutrition Component of the NELIP Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13468203.creator: Karishma Hosein, Taniya S. Nagpal, Roberta Bgeginski, Isabelle Giroux, Harry Prapavessis, Michelle F. Mottola
pmc-13468203.description: Background/Objectives: To examine adherence to the specific goals of the nutrition component of a healthy lifestyle intervention program during pregnancy (the Nutrition and Exercise Lifestyle Intervention Program; NELIP) from baseline at 12–18 weeks gestation to trial midpoint (24–25 weeks gestation) and endpoint (34–36 weeks gestation). Methods: A convenience sample of 90 individuals were included in the secondary analysis.

pmc-13483406.title: Viral spectrum differences between outpatients and inpatients with suspected pediatric acute respiratory infections: a prospective sentinel surveillance study in Pudong, Shanghai, China
pmc-13483406.creator: Zou Chen, Xuechun Zhang, Li Zhang, Chuchu Ye, Yifeng Shen, Rongxin Wu, Bing Zhao, Lipeng Hao
pmc-13483406.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAcute respiratory infections (ARIs) remain a leading cause of pediatric morbidity worldwide. However, comparative data on the viral spectra driving these infections across outpatient and inpatient settings within integrated unified health systems remain limited, especially in the post-COVID-19 era.MethodsWe conducted a prospective sentinel surveillance study in Pudong New Area, Shanghai (April 2023–March 2025), enrolling children under 15 years who presented with ARIs from both outpatient and inpatient settings.

pmc-13659762.title: Protocol for generating highly enriched sex-specific primary cortical astrocytes from individual mouse pups
pmc-13659762.creator: Sanarya Al-Jaf, En-Hung Ai, Julia A Wilson, Khaled S Abd-Elrahman
pmc-13659762.description: SummaryHere, we present a protocol for generating highly enriched primary cortical astrocytes from individual neonatal mouse pups. We describe steps for mechanically dissociating cortical tissue, culturing in coated flasks, and removing oligodendrocyte progenitor cells through mechanical shaking and selective pharmacological depletion of microglia.
